# Meet Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut™ and Cricut StickerPix Print™


-
-
-


24 September 2026


[Cricut](https://cricut.com/blog/author/cricut/)


---


Easily bring your camera roll to life with the brand-new Cricut StickerPix™ machines. Create custom, pro-quality stickers, labels, photo prints, cards, and invitations — at home, in minutes.


## What is Cricut StickerPix?


Cricut StickerPix is our new line of sticker machines. There are two machines: a sticker and photo printer + cutter, Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut, and a sticker and photo printer, Cricut StickerPix Print. The machines are both compact and come in cute new colors with an all-in-one design that means no extra steps or tools needed.


### Print shop quality at home


With Cricut StickerPix machines, expect high-resolution detail and ultra-vivid color in every print. No more driving to the shop to pick up photos or ordering custom stickers in bulk. Create personalized pro-quality stickers, photo prints, and more from the convenience of your home. Because great ideas shouldn’t have to wait.


### Dye-sublimation printing


Both sticker machines use dye-sublimation technology, which uses heat to transfer dye directly onto the material instead of spraying on ink droplets like traditional printers. The result is smooth, continuous color that’s especially well suited to photos.


### Lamination process


Both sticker machines laminate to add a layer of protection for prints that are water-, scratch-, and fade-resistant.


## Effortlessly transform your photos with Design Space® software


Go from an idea to a full sticker sheet with one-click photo transformations and editable templates in Design Space®.* Our all-new software experience allows you to apply unique effects and styles to your photos, plus use editable templates for easy and custom designs. Simply grab photos from your camera roll and turn everyday moments into something you can hold.


## Cricut StickerPix Print™ vs. Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut™


### Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut™


Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut is an all-in-one sticker and photo printer with precision-cutting capabilities. It’s the larger of the two Cricut StickerPix machines and is compatible with 4 in x 7 in Sticker Sheets and 4 in x 6 in Photo Paper.


### Cricut StickerPix Print™


Cricut StickerPix Print works similarly to Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut. However, instead of precision-cutting your stickers, it uses pre-cut sticker sheets.


This machine is compatible with 1.5 in Circle Pre-cut Sticker Sheets, 1 in x 2.6 in Rectangle Pre-cut Sticker Sheets, 1.5 in Square Pre-cut Sticker Sheets, and 4 in x 6 in Photo Paper.


Cricut StickerPix Print is also the smaller of the Cricut StickerPix machines, measuring 7.8 in x 5 in x 3.5 in, versus Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut’s 8 in x 11.3 in x 4.1 in size.


## What’s the difference between making stickers with Cricut StickerPix machines vs Cricut cutting machines?


While you can make custom stickers with Cricut StickerPix machines and select Cricut cutting machines, there are three main differences in the process and output.


### Home inkjet printer


Cricut cutting machines do not have print functionality and require an at-home inkjet printer. Cricut StickerPix machines use ink cartridges built into the machine and do not need an at-home inkjet printer.


### Die-cut vs kiss-cut stickers


Cricut StickerPix machines can only make kiss-cut custom stickers for easy peeling, while Cricut cutting machines can do either die-cut or kiss-cut.


### Laminate sheets vs laminate coating


Cricut StickerPix machines have laminate coating already built into the printing process.


Cricut cutting machines, on the other hand, use laminate sheets that must be manually applied by the user to achieve a water-resistant coating. These laminate sheets also come in fun styles to add different effects to your stickers, such as a holographic finish.


## Buy your Cricut StickerPix machine today


[Shop our new Cricut StickerPix line](https://cricut.com/en-us/discover-sticker-machines) beginning September 24, 2026, and experience the magic of creating custom, pro-quality stickers, photo prints, and more, right from the comfort of your home.


## FAQs


####


It depends on what you’re after. If you want the freedom to create with custom shapes, we recommend Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut so you can precision-cut your stickers and labels.

Yes, Cricut StickerPix machines work with compatible mobile devices and the Design Space® app,* allowing you to print photos and stickers directly from a phone or tablet.


*Certain software features require paid subscription. See cricut.com for terms and details.


####


The printer heats a ribbon of colored dye and transfers it into the coated surface of the material one color at a time, then finishes with a clear protective layer. Because the dye becomes part of the material, prints are smooth and durable.


####


It’s easy — simply upload your photo into Design Space, choose a sticker type (varies by machine), then print using compatible Sticker Sheets.


####


Pre-cut stickers come in set shapes already cut into the sheet. Custom-shape stickers are cut to whatever outline your design has. Kiss-cut means only the sticker is cut and the backing stays intact, so it peels easily while die-cut means the sticker and its backing are both cut through. Cricut StickerPix machines only print on Pre-cut Sticker Sheets (Cricut StickerPix Print) or kiss-cut on Sticker Sheets (Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut).


####


Cricut StickerPix machines laminate your stickers as they print, making them water-, scratch-, and fade- resistant.


####


While you can make labels using Cricut StickerPix machines, they are not technically label printers. They are sticker machines.


Label printers are built for text — shipping labels, barcodes, and organization — and usually print in one or two colors on plain label stock. Sticker machines print full-color photos and designs and have an adhesive backing.


####


Yes. Cricut StickerPix Print is only compatible with Cricut StickerPix Print Photo Paper and Pre-cut Sticker Sheets. Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut is only compatible with Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut Photo Paper and Sticker Sheets. The ink cartridges are only compatible with their specific machine. Neither materials nor ink cartridges for the Cricut StickerPix machines are cross-compatible.


####


Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut is compatible with 4 in x 6 in Photo Paper and 4 in x 7 in Sticker Sheets and Cricut StickerPix


Cricut StickerPix Print is compatible with 4 in x 6 in Photo Paper and 4 in x 6 in Pre-cut Sticker Sheets.


**Cricut StickerPix™ machines are not intended for use by children 12 years and younger. Requires mobile phone, tablet, or computer with Bluetooth® wireless and high-speed internet connection. System requirements may change. For details and updates on compatibility with all devices, browsers, and operating systems, see cricut.com/systemrequirements. Only Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut™ has cutting capabilities with an included blade; Cricut StickerPix Print™ prints and prints on Cricut Pre-cut Sticker Sheets.
